text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People are still only talking about Shinko 
Windy's biting incident.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eager to overwrite the image next time, 
she geared up. However, spurred by 
impatience, her already shaky focus grew 
even more scattered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, the Trainer suggested creating a 
mental "switch." She was instructed to 
narrow her focus while running and look 
only at what lay ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through training, Shinko Windy mastered 
the "Dark Switch." Using this strategy to 
sharpen her focus, she set her sights on 
winning the Tokai Stakes.
